title: Nametag, Saddle and Bundle Recipes
description: Adds nametag, saddle and bundle recipes to minecraft older versions.
body:
### Recipes for older versions (1.20.6 and below) soon.

This Datapack add Nametag, Saddle and Bundle official recipes in older versions of Minecraft.
and no it doesn't add bundles before 1.17, obvious right?

Look at **Gallery** to view the recipes.
